findings.content: The top-level `web` block is not part of `OrchestratorConfig`, and the web monitoring server is configured only from CLI flags (`--web`, `--web-port`, `--web-bind`) when starting TUI/run. Because serde ignores unknown fields by default, these settings are silently ignored, so the checked-in port/bind/refresh interval do not affect cflx behavior.

The checked-in comment says this is web monitoring server configuration, but the documented configuration contract only enables web monitoring via `web.enabled = true`; this block omits `enabled` and includes `refresh_interval_secs`, which is not documented in the configuration spec. As written, the example implies behavior that the documented CLI/config contract does not provide.
